UTILIZATION AND RECOGNITION OF PARA-LEGAL VOLUNTEERS 
 
2830 SHRI MANOJ KUMAR JHA: 
 
Will the Minister of Law and Justice be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Para -Legal Volunteers (PLVs) play a vital role in providing free legal aid, if so,  
State-wise distribution in the country; 
(b) whether Government is aware of challenges like lack of training, monitoring, incentives and 
public trust in PLVs, if so, the details thereof; 
(c) the steps taken to provide training, resources and adequate compensation to PLVs and 
measures to enhance public awareness and trust in their role; and 
(d) the measures being implemented to ensure effective utilization and recognition of PLVs in 
bridging the gap between the legal system and citizens? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) OF THE MINISTRY OF LAW AND 
JUSTICE; AND MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PARLIAM ENTARY 
AFFAIRS 
(SHRI ARJUN RAM MEGHWAL) 
 
 
(a) : The Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) act as intermediaries between the common citizens and 
the Legal Services Institutions in providing free legal aid ensuring access to justice. The 
State-wise distribution/ availability of PLVs is at Annexure-A.  
 
 
 
 
(1) 
335

 
(b) to (d): The Para-Legal Volunteers Schemewas introduced by the National Legal Services 
Authority (NALSA) in the year 2009, with an aim to impart legal training to the volunteers, 
selected from different walks of life so as to ensure that legal aid reach es the citizens 
ensuring access to justice. The scheme was revised in 2017 and re -named as ‘Scheme for 
Para-legal Volunteers (Revised), 2017’. 
 
To enhance the capacities of PLVs, especially their skills  and representation, NALSA has 
prepared an extensive  training module namely “Modulefor Training of  Para-legal 
Volunteers”. This Module is intended to sensitize the PLVs on the Constitutional vision of 
justice, basics of criminal law, labour laws, law for juveniles and laws for protection of 
women and senior citizens. It lays emphasis on knowledge of procedure as well as social 
sensitivity, soft skills of behavior and communication skills essential for dealing with a 
diverse population. 
 
 Under the supervision of Chairman, District Legal Services Authority  (DLSA), PLVs 
undergo training programmes . In addition to orientation and induction trainings, refresher 
training is also provided to the PLVs from time to time in order to upgrade their skills. The 
Legal Services Authorities periodically assess the work of PLVs and assist them in 
identifying the deficits and to tackle the problems in the field.  The DLSAs upgrad e their 
skills as per the module. The minimum incentive to the PLVs has been provided as Rs 250/ - 
per day under the scheme .  However, the S tate Legal Services Authorities (S LSAs) may fix 
the honorarium of the PLVs more than Rs. 250/- per day depending on local circumstances.  
 
 Recently, NALSA has issued directions to all the SLSAs with a request that PLVs are to be 
additionally referred to as “Adhikar Mitra” ( meaning “A Friend of Rights”)  in all 
programmes organised by the Legal Services Institutions and in all documents, 
correspondences, Information, Education and Communication (I EC) material etc. prepared, 
circulated and distributed by the Legal Service Institutions. The exemplary services of PLVs 
are given recognition and are rewarded for providing the best services to the beneficiaries.

IMPACT OF THE LOKPAL ON HANDLING PUBLIC GRIEVANCES 
 
2831. SMT. RANJEET RANJAN: 
 
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:  
 
(a) the total number of cases of corruption or misconduct referred to the Lokpal and the outcomes  
of these cases over the last two years;   
(b) the steps taken to strengthen the role of the Lokpal in promoting accountability and handling  
complaints of corruption within public services; 
(c) the key challenges faced by the Lokpal in investigating and prosecuting cases of 
corruption, and  the measures implemented to overcome these challenges; and 
(d) whether Government is conducting any public awareness campaigns or outreach 
programmes to  inform citizens about the role of the Lokpal and the process for filing complaints? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC GRIEVANCES 
AND PENSIONS AND MINISTER OF STATE IN THE PRIME MINISTER’S OFFICE 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH) 
 
(a): During the financial year 2023-24, a total of 166 complaints were registered with the 
Lokpal, out of which a total of 156 complaints have been disposed of as on 30.11.2024. 
During the financial year 2024-25 (till 30.11.2024), a total of 210 complaints have been 
registered with the Lokpal, out of which a total of 158 complaints have been disposed of as on 
30.11.2024. 
(b & c): Rules for functioning of the Lokpal including the Lokpal (Complaints) Rules, 2020 have 
already been notified. 
The complaints received by the Lokpal are handled as per the provision of the Lokpal 
and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 and the rules framed thereunder.  
(d): All the details viz. jurisdiction and function of the Lokpal, process of filings of

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2832 
(TO BE ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024) 
 
REFORMS IN CPGRAMS 
 
2832. DR. MEDHA VISHRAM KULKARNI:  
          SHRI BABURAM NISHAD:  
          SHRI MADAN RATHORE: 
 
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:  
 
(a) the details of the ten-step reforms in Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring 
System (CPGRAMS) that have improved grievance management; and 
(b) whether Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) will be used to modernise the  
grievance redressal process, if so, the details thereof?  
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC GRIEVANCES 
AND PENSIONS AND MINISTER OF STATE IN THE PRIME MINISTER’S OFFICE 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH) 
 
(a) & (b): The Government introduced the 10-step reforms for Centralized Public Grievance 
Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) in April 2022 to make grievance redressal timely, 
effective and accessible to the Citizens.  In the period from 2022, 2023 and 2024, the CPGRAMS 
10 step reforms enabled redressal of about 70,03,533 grievances, mapped 1,03,183 Grievance 
Officers (GROs), reduced timelines of grievance redressal from 28 days in 2019 to 13 days in 
2024 and reduced pendency to its lowest level of 54,339 Public Grievances as on 31 October 
2024 for Central Ministries. The 10 step reforms are (i) Universalization of CPGRAMS 7.0, (ii) 
Technological Enhancements, (iii) Language Translation, (iv) Grievance Redressal Assessment 
Index (GRAI) (v) Citizen engagement through feedback calls (vi) One Nation one Portal, (vii) 
Inclusivity & Outreach (viii) Training and Capacity Building of GROs, (ix) Strengthening 
monitoring through monthly reviews and reports  and (x) Operationalization of Data Strategy 
Unit.  CPGRAMS is amongst the early digital platforms to use AI/ ML enabled dashboards 
which helped in extensive data analysis towards exploratory and predictive insights for root 
cause of grievances and enable suitable intervention towards systemic reforms.

(DR. JITENDRA SINGH)

Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) in last five years from 2020- 2024 (upto 31.10.2024) 
and an annual all-time high of 23,24,323 grievances have been redressed on CPGRAMS portal 
from January-October, 2024. The Government has adopted 10 Step reforms of CPGRAMS to make 
grievance redressal timely, effective and accessible to Citizen. The Government has mapped over 
one lakh Grievance Officers on the CPGRAMS portal which helped in bringing down the pendency 
to its lowest level of 54,339 Public Grievances as on 31 October 2024 for Central Ministries. 
Government has issued Comprehensive Guidelines for Effective Redressal of Public Grievances on 
23rd August 2024. These guidelines include creation of dedicated grievance cells in 
Ministries/Departments, appointment of experienced and competent nodal officers, emphasis on 
root cause analysis of grievances and action on feedback, strengthening escalation processes by 
appointing appellate authorities, grievance closure guidelines with further reduction in upper limit 
of resolution time from 30 days to 21 days. Those efforts have helped in reduction of average 
timelines of redressal from 28 days in 2019 to 13 days in 2024.

2845.  SHRI ASHOKRAO SHANKARRAO CHAVAN: 
 
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Anusandhan  National Research Foundation (ANRF) has launched the 
‘Partnership for Accelerated Innovation and Research ’ an initiative to enhance research 
capabilities of universities particularly Central and State public institutions in the country; 
(b) if so, details thereof;  
(c) whether Government has identified universities and institutions selected for the said 
purpose; 
(d) if so, details thereof and the criteria being followed for identification and selection of 
said universities/institutions; 
(e) the amount of funds sanctioned/released for each selected university or institution for 
the above said purpose; and 
(f) the ratio in which budget will be shared by Centre and State Governments? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) FOR THE  
MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY & EARTH SCIENCES 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH) 
 
(a) to (b): Yes, Sir. The Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) has launched 
the ‘Partnership for Accelerated Innovation and Research (PAIR) ’ an initiative to enhance 
research capabilities of universities particularly Central and State public institutions in the 
country. PAIR is a multi-institutional programme to boost research capability of institutions, 
where research is relatively at nascent stage, through a mentorship -driven hub and spoke 
framework by pairing them with well -established top tier institutions. Hubs will guide 
emerging institutions (spokes) in research activities, provide access to harness their resources 
and expertise, thus bridging the gap between institutions and nurturing a  robust research 
ecosystem in the country. 
 
(c) The PAIR programme was launched on November 14, 2024  and no universities and 
institutions have been selected so far under the programme. 
 
(d) Institutions/universities will be identified  from among the ones with the following 
eligibility criteria. Hub Institutions should be those institutions within 25 National Institutional 
353

Page 2 of 2 
 
Ranking Framework (NIRF) overall rankings in the preceding two years or institutions of 
national importance within 26 to 50 NIRF overall ranking in the preceding two years. Spoke 
Institutions should be Central Universities and State Public Universities within 200 NIRF 
overall ranking or within 200 NIRF University ranking or within 100 NIRF State Public 
University ranking, excluding those eligible as Hubs. Additionally, other Central and State 
Public Universities which are not NIRF ranked but have potential in specific research areas, 
are also eligible as spoke institutions, subject to a maximum of one such institution i n each 
PAIR Network.  Select emerging National Institute of Technology and Indian Institute of 
Information Technology with promising research competence are also eligible as spoke 
institutions. Each PAIR network will consist of a Hub and 3 to 7 spoke institutions and to ensure 
regional diversity, at least one spoke institution must be located outside the State of the Hub 
institution. Based on the merit of the proposal , ANRF, on recommendation of an Apex 
Committee of ANRF, will select the PAIR network. 
 
(e) No fund release has been made so far under the programme. 
  
(f) The programme will be fully funded by the Central Government through ANRF.

with respect to other countries;

(c) the benefits realised so far; and 
(d) the proposed measures to be taken in this regard?  
  
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) FOR THE  
MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY & EARTH SCIENCES 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH) 
  
(a) Ministry of Science and Technology is facilitating international cooperation in all major 
areas of Science, Technology and Innovation with 40 countries through instruments such as 
Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), Lette r of Intent (LoI), Programme of Cooperation 
(PoC) or other Agreements. Every year, the Department of Science and Technology (DST) 
launches about 15-18 joint calls for Research and Development (R&D) proposals to enhance 
international bilateral collaboration  as well as multilateral collaboration. India is also 
participating in the state -of-the-art research facilities like Facility for Antiproton and Ion 
Research (FAIR) in Germany, Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT) in USA, Square Kilometer Array 
(SKA) in Australia and South Africa wherein India works closely with many leading countries 
across the globe. India is also a part of European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN, 
Geneva); ELLETRA Synchrotron (Italy); Sp-Ring-8 (Japan); KEK Accelerator (Japan); Fermi-
Lab (US); Synchrotron light source (Brazil and Singapore); Synchrotron Radiation Sources 
Beam-line (Russia) etc. Global Centre for Nuclear Energy Partnership (GCNEP), a constituent 
unit of the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) is having MoUs with 16 international partners

including USA, Russia, IAEA, France, etc. to strengthen global partnerships to promote safe, 
secure and sustainable nuclear energy for the service of mankind.

different areas of S&T. These projects are progressing well in terms of their objectives and 
outcome. Details of projects progressing in this respect, country -wise, field-wise are given in 
the Annexure.

particularly in the frontier areas of S&T and in areas addressing glo bal challenges. The

programmes, increased research capacity building and infrastructure development, exchange 
and exposure visits, access to advanced facilities, t echnology transfer, joint publications etc.

UNSTARRED QUESTION No. 2847 
ANSWERED ON 19/12/2024 
 
NANOCOATING MATERIAL IN CHEMICAL AND FERTILIZERS 
2847. SHRI DHANANJAY BHIMRAO MAHADIK: 
Will The Minister of SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state: 
(a) whether it is a fact that nanocoating material can enhance the nutrient use efficiency 
of chemical and fertilizers in farming;  
(b) If so, the details thereof; and 
(c) the steps taken by Government to enhance the use of this nanocoating material in 
chemicals and fertilizers? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) FOR THE  
MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY & EARTH SCIENCES 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH) 
(a) to (b): Yes Sir, nanocoating  materials can enhance the nutrient use efficiency of 
chemicals and fertilizers in farming. Nanocoating of fertilizers involves applying nanoscale 
materials or thin films over the surface of fertilizer granules. This approach improves the 
release performance of fertilizers, addressing issues such as nutrient loss and uncontrolled 
release, which are common in conventional fertilizers. With an aim to provide farmers the 
means to boost productivity and help increase their income, Nano DAP is an efficient source 
of available nitrogen and phosphorus for all the crops and helps in correcting the Nitrogen 
& Phosphorus deficiencies in standing crops. It is available in the market. 
(c) The Ministry of Science and Technology supports R&D projects in the area of nano-
biotechnology with an aim to enhance properties of soil and agriculture inputs including 
fertilizers for improving overall crop performance.

(a) & (b)

TO BE ANSWERED ON THURSDAY, DECEMBER 19, 2024 
 
BHARATIYA ANTRIKSH STATION 
 
2851.  SHRI NARHARI AMIN: 
  
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the details on the objectives and expected capabilities of the Bharatiya Antriksh 
Station in comparison to other space stations; and 
(b) the timeline for the construction and operationalisation of the Bharatiya Antriksh 
Station and milestones set to ensure its timely completion? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC 
GRIEVANCES & PENSIONS AND IN THE PRIME MINISTER’S OFFICE 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH): 
****   
(a) Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS) will fulfil the objective of an orbiting Indian human 
spaceflight platform in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). This will enable to undertake medium 
to long duration human space flight missions to LEO, as part of the sustained Indian 
human space progra m. Similar to other operational space stations, BAS will also 
comprise of multiple modules and state of the art technological capabilities for carrying 
out cutting edge scientific research and technology development activities in 
microgravity environment, targeted towards national priorities and societal 
applications. 
(b) With the recent approval of revision in Gaganyaan Programme, the scope of the 
program has been expanded to include precursor missions to Bharatiya Antariksh 
Station (BAS), including developmen t & launch of 1 st module of BAS (BAS -01). The 
1st module of BAS is targeted to be launched in 2028 timeframe and BAS is expected to 
be fully operationalised with all modules by 2035 timeframe.

INDIA’S SPACE VISION 2047 
 
2852.  SHRI RAMBHAI HARJIBHAI MOKARIYA: 
 SHRI NARHARI AMIN: 
 SMT. DARSHANA SINGH: 
  
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the details of goal of establishing Bhartiya Antriksh Station to enhance possibilities of 
future exploration programmes; and 
(b) the details of scheduled ambitious indigenous programmes to achieve India’s Space

ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC GRIEVANCES 
& PENSIONS AND IN THE PRIME MINISTER’S OFFICE 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH): 
****   
(a) The vision for space in the Amrit kaal  envisages including other things, establishing an 
operational Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS) by 2035 and Indian Crewed Lunar 
Mission by 2040. BAS will be the first National Space Laboratory to conduct 
multidisciplinary microgravity experiments and stud ies in the fields of Science, 
Technologies, Medicine, Agriculture, Space manufacturing, among others. BAS will also 
be acting as platform for global & national collaboration, gateway to lunar exploration & 
beyond and to help boosting the Space Economy of the country. 
366

ISRO has initiated development of various technologies for the Bharatiya Antariksh 
Station. These technologies will be demonstrated through precursor missions for BAS, 
which has been recently approved by the Government as part of revision in Ga ganyaan 
programme. 
(b) Department of Space leap towards India’s Space Vision 2047 with the approvals of key 
Missions which includes, 
 Establishment of 1st module of Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS) by 2028,  
 Development of Next Generation of satellite Launch V ehicle (NGLV) ( Re-Usable 
Low-cost launch vehicle) by 2032,  
 Chandrayaan-4 by 2027, to develop and demonstrate the technologies to come back 
to Earth after successful landing on the Moon and also collect moon samples, and  
 Venus Orbiter Mission (VOM) by 202 8, to study the Venusian surface and 
subsurface, atmospheric processes and influence of Sun on Venusian Atmosphere.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2858 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024 
 
SPIRITUAL TOURISM PROJECTS 
 
2858 SHRI SANDOSH KUMAR P: 
 
 Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the State-wise list of projects under the spiritual tourism projects in the country; 
(b) the State -wise details of the funds allotted to each project under the spiritual tourism 
projects; 
(c) whether Government is planning to develop new projects under this initiative;  and  
(d) if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM             (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (b):  The Ministry of Tourism under the “Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, 
Heritage Augmentation Drive” (PRASHAD) provides financial assistance to the State 
Governments and Union Territories Administrations for development of tourism infrastructure at 
identified pilgrimage and heritage destinations. The Ministry has sanctioned 48 projects across 
the country, and 29 sites have been identified for development under its PRASHAD Scheme. 
 
The Ministry of Tourism under Swadesh Darshan scheme sanctioned 76 projects under identified 
thematic circuits for ₹5287.90 Crore, including 13 projects under the ‘Spiritual Circuit’ theme. 
The Ministry of Tourism has also issued guidelines for ‘Challenge Based Destination 
Development (CBDD)’, a sub -scheme under Swadesh Darshan 2.0. This sub -scheme aims for 
holistic development of destination to enhance tourist experience and the Ministry has identified 
42 destinations under CBDD  in the country including 11 projects under Spiritual tourism 
category. 
 
The details of the projects sanctioned and sites/destinations identified under the PRASHAD, 
Spiritual Circuit of SD, CBDD (Spiritual Tourism Category) are given in the annexure. 
 
(c) to (d): Receiving proposals from the State Governments/UT Administrations for 
financial assistance for tourism projects is a continuous process. The proposals received are 
examined with reference to the prescribed guidelines and financial assistance is extended for 
such projects subject to fulfilment of the stipulated conditions and availability of funds.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF TOURISM 
  
RAJYA SABHA 
   UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2859 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024 
  
PRASHAD SCHEME 
 
2859  SMT. KIRAN CHOUDHRY: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the funds allocated and utilized in Haryana in the last five years under the PRASHAD 
scheme; 
(b) the details of sites developed under the scheme; 
(c) whether the scheme has resulted in higher tourist footfall in Haryana; and 
(d) if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM     (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a): The Ministry of Tourism under the “Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage 
Augmentation Drive” (PRASHAD) provides financial assistance to the State Governments and 
Union Territories Administrations for development of tourism infrastructure at identified 
pilgrimage and heritage destinations.  
Under the PRASHAD Scheme, the Ministry has sanctioned a project namely, “Development of 
Nada Saheb Gurdwara and Mata Mansa Devi Temple in Panchkula District, Haryana” at a cost of 
Rs.48.53 Crore. An amount of Rs.34.68 crore has been released for the project till date, which has 
been fully utilized.  
(b): The project “Development of Nada Sah eb Gurudwara and Mata Mansa Devi Temple in 
Panchkula District, Haryana” includes the development of two sites namely, Nada Saheb 
Gurudwara and Mata Mansa Devi Temple. The components developed in Nada Saheb Gurudwara, 
Panchkula includes Gurudwara Area Development, Surface Parking development, Multi -Level Car 
Parking and Integrated Area Development. The components developed in Mata Mansa Devi 
Temple, Panchkula, includes Temple Area Development, Parking area development including 
multi-level car parking and Integrated area development. 
 (c) & (d): The State Government of Haryana has informed that it has not conducted any study 
to assess the increase in tourist footfall.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF TOURISM 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2860# 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024 
 
SWADESH DARSHAN SCHEME 
 
2860# MS. INDU BALA GOSWAMI: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the cities selected as tourist destinations under the Swadesh Darshan Scheme; 
(b) whether any scheme has been formulated to develop tourism in border areas and villages under 
the said scheme; and 
(c) if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM                     (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (c): Development and promotion of tourism is primarily undertaken by the concerned State 
Governments (SGs)/Union Territory Administrations (UTs). However , the Ministry of Tourism under 
its Swadesh Darshan scheme provides  financial assistance to SGs/UTs for  developing tourism  
amenities under the scheme and has sanctioned 76 projects for Rs.5287.90 Crore in the country under 
identified thematic circuits including rural tourism circuit.  
 
The Ministry has  revamped the Swadesh Darshan scheme  as Swadesh Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0)  with the 
objective to develop sustainable and responsible tourism destinations and has sanctioned 34 projects 
for Rs.793.20 Crore including  projects in border area. In  addition, Ministry of Tourism  under its 
‘Challenge Based Destination Development (CBDD)’, a  sub-scheme of  Swadesh Darshan has  
identified 42 destinations in the country including  5 destinations in  Vibrant Village category. The 
Ministry has not formulated a separate scheme for developing tourism amenities in rural and border 
areas, however, interventions under existing schemes include developing facilities in different parts of 
the country including rural and border regions. The details of the  projects sanctioned under Swadesh 
Darshan and SD2.0 and destinations identified in CBDD in the country is annexed.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2861# 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024 
 
PLAN TO PROMOTE TOURISM SECTOR 
 
2861# SMT. SUNETRA AJIT PAWAR: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government proposes to promote the tourism sector in the country during 
Amrit Kaal; 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; 
(c)  the number of foreign tourists visiting India at present; 
(d)  the steps taken by Government to ensure an increase in the number of foreign tourists 
visiting India; 
(e)  whether there is a need to improve the railway network and other infrastructure to 
strengthen the tourism sector; and 
(f)  if so, the response of Government in this regard and the steps taken or proposed to be 
taken to improve the railway netw ork and other infrastructure to attract foreign 
tourists? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM         (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (f): In order to promote the tourism sector in the country during Amrit Kaal, the 
Ministry of Tourism has taken the following initiatives:- 
 
• The Ministry of Tourism undertakes several promotional activities in potential 
international & domestic markets to promote various tourism destinations and 
products of the country in holistic manner. This includes release of media campaigns, 
social media promotions, webinars, participation & support to promotional events, 
dissemination of information and engagement through website etc. In addition, Indian 
Missions overseas also undertake various promotional activities to attract more global 
travelers to various tourist destinations of the country. 
• Ministry of Tourism launched the Incredible India Content Hub on the revamped 
Incredible India digital portal which is a comprehensive digital repository, featuring a 
rich collection of high -quality images, films, brochures, and newsletters related to 
tourism in India. This repository is intended for the use of a diverse range of 
stakeholders, including tour operators, journalists, students, researchers, film makers, 
authors, influencers, content creators, government officials and ambassadors. 
• The Ministry of Tourism under the schemes of ‘Swadesh Darshan’, National Mission 
on Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)’ 
and ‘Assistance to Central Agencies for Tourism Infrastructure Development’ 
393

provides financial assistance to State Governments/Union Territory 
Administrations/Central Agencies for the development of tourism related 
infrastructure and facilities at various tourism destinations in the country. 
• Ministry has revamped Swadesh Darshan Scheme as Swadesh Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0) 
with the objective to develop sustainable and responsible destinations following a 
destination centric approach.  
• Under ‘Scheme for  Special Assistance to States/Union Territories for Capital 
Investment (SASCI)’ Government of India has recently sanctioned 40 Projects in the 
country for Rs.3295.76 Crore. 
• Ministry of Tourism has been providing financial assistance to State Governments/ 
UT Administrations for organising fairs/festivals and tourism related events.  
• Ministry is conducting Programmes under the ‘Capacity Building for Service 
Providers’ (CBSP) Scheme to train and upgrade manpower to provide better service 
standards. 
• To enhance the overall experience of tourists by making available a pool of local, 
trained professionals at tourist sites across the country, Ministry launched the 
Incredible India Tourist Facilitator (IITF) Certification Programme – a Pan -India 
online learning program.  
 
Indian Railways have taken various steps to improve the railway network and other 
infrastructures, which are outlined below: 
 
i.  Railway Infrastructure Projects are taken up on the basis of remunerativeness, last 
mile connectivity, missing links and alternate routes, augmentation of 
congested/saturated lines, socio -economic considerations, enhancing connectivity to 
tourist and cultural places etc. depending upon liabilities of ongoing projects, overall 
availability of funds and competing demands. As on 01.04.2024, out of 488 Railway 
Infrastructure projects (187 New Line, 40 Gauge Conversion and 261 Doubling) of 
total length 44,488 Km costing approx. Rs.7.44 lakh crore, 12,045 Km length has 
been commissioned across Indian Railways with an expenditure of Rs.2.92 lakh crore. 
Augmenting railway infrastructures across Indian Railways is an ongoing and 
continuous process. 
ii.  The Ministry of Railways has recently launched the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme for 
development of Railway stations on Indian Railways. The Scheme envisages 
development of stations on a continuous basis with a long -term approach. It involves 
preparation of Master Plans and their implementation in phases to improve amenities 
at stations, like improvement of station access, circulating areas, waiting halls, toilets, 
lift/escalators as necessary, platform surfacing and cover over platform, cleanliness, 
free Wi-Fi, kiosks for local products through schemes like 'One Station One Product', 
better passenger information systems, Executive Lounges, nominated spaces for 
business meetings, landscaping etc. keeping in view the necessity at each station. The 
scheme also envisages improvement of building, integrating the station with both 
sides of the city, multimodal integration, and amenities for Divyangjans, sustainable 
394

and environment friendly solutions, provision of ballastless tracks, etc. as per 
necessity, phasing and feasibility. So far, 1337 stations have been identified under the 
Amrit Bharat Station Scheme over Indian Railways. 
iii.  Under the National Rail Plan (NRP), around 243 tourist destinations in India were 
identified. Out of these, 111 places are already connected with the existing rail 
network, 30 tourist places are within a distance of 10 kms from the nearest railway 
station and 30 are within a distance of 15 kms from the nearest railway station. The 
remaining 72 locations are primarily wildlife sanctuaries, beaches and areas located in 
hilly and mountainous terrain where providing rail connectivity is either not advisable 
or difficult. 
 
Further, with a view to provide enhanced amenities and facilities for tourists, projects for 
joint development of tourist amenities at 22 railway stations  by the Ministry of Railways 
(MoR) and Ministry of Tourism were sanctioned on cost sharing basis.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2862# 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024  
 
DEKHO APNA DESH CAMPAIGN 
 
2862# SHRI TEJVEER SINGH: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has taken any new steps to promote tourism for Indian citizens  under 
the Dekho Apna Desh campaign and the number of tourist destinations that have  been 
promoted under it; 
(b) whether Government has used digital or other mediums to make people aware of  tourist 
destinations through the Dekho Apna Desh campaign; and 
(c) whether Government has announced special tourism packages for Indian citizens under  the 
Dekho Apna Desh campaign and the impact of the initiative thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM          (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (c): The Ministry of Tourism had launched the Dekho Apna Desh initiative in January 
2020 for promotion of domestic tourism in the country. Under this initiative, the Ministry promotes 
tourism destinations and products of India through various activities such as Webinars, Quiz, Pledge, 
Seminars, Tourism Promotional Events, Fam tours, Website, Social Media etc. 
 
Ministry of Tourism launched Dekho Apna Desh People’s Choice poll with aim to engage 
with citizens to identify most preferred tourist attractions across 5 tourism categories - Spiritual, 
Nature & Wildlife, Adventure, Cultural & Heritage  and others. The Ministry has promoted the 
People’s choice poll through various platforms, including Digital, Social Media, Print, Outdoor, 
SMS and WhatsApp. 
 
Tour programmes such as package tours for foreign and domestic tourists are provided by the 
Private Stakeholders, Public Sector Undertakings and the State Governments.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF TOURISM 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2864# 
ANSWERED ON 19.12.2024 
 
INDIA'S RANKING IN THE TRAVEL AND TOURISM DEVELOPMENT INDEX 
 
2864# SHRI IMRAN PRATAPGARHI:  
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state:                               
 
(a)  whether India’s ranking in the Travel and Tourism Development Index 2024 conducted by the 
World Economic Forum has dropped ten places to the 39 th as compared to 2019, if so, reasons 
for the dip in ranking and efforts made by Government to prevent it;  
(b)  the budget allocated by Government for enhancement of tourist places in the last five years 
along with the reasons for no improvement in the ranking; and 
(c)  whether Government is formulating any policy to address the problem of limited access to 
health services for foreign and domestic tourists, which has also been cited as one of the 
reasons? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM                                      (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a): According to the Travel and Tourism Development Index (TTDI) 2024 report published by the 
World Economic Forum (WEF), India is ranked 39th among 119 countries. In the previous index 
published in 2021, India was ranked 54th. However, due to a revision in the WEF's methodology, 
India's 2021 rank was adjusted to 38th place. 
 
(b): The Ministry of Tourism under the schemes of ‘Swadesh Darshan’, ‘National Mission on 
Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)’ and ‘Assistance to 
Central Agencies for Tourism Infrastructure Development’ provides financial assistance to State 
Governments/Union Territory Administrations/Central Agencies for the development of tourism 
related infrastructure and facilities at various tourism destinations in the country. The d etails of 
projects sanctioned under these schemes are annexed. 
 
(c): As per information received,  the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has launched India’s 
official portal for Medical Value Travel (MVT), which is the Advantage Healthcare India portal. It is a 
“One-Stop” portal developed for the facilitation of information for those who want to avail medical 
treatment in India from abroad. Any international patient seeking medical care or wellness services in 
India can visit the Advantage Healthcare India portal by logging on to www.healinindia.gov.in.

SUSTAINABLE TOURISM IN GOA 
 
2865 SHRI SADANAND MHALU SHET TANA V ADE: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) initiatives taken by Government to promote sustainable tourism in Goa, while ensuring the 
preservation of its local culture and environment; 
(b) the funds allocated for tourism infrastructure development in Goa for the current fiscal year, and 
specific projects included in this allocation; 
(c) statistics on tourist arrivals in Goa, along with an assessment of their impact on local businesses 
and employment; and 
(d) measures being taken to promote Goa as an off -season tourism destination, in order to reduce the 
pressure on local infrastructure and resources during peak tourist seasons? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM                           (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (d): The Ministry of Tourism promotes India in a holistic manner as a 365 days destination, 
through various initiatives. As part of on -going activities; promotion of sustainable tourism in all 
States/Union Territories, is also taken up. The Ministry of Tourism regularly promotes sustainable 
tourism through its website and social media promotions.  The Ministry also promotes lesser known 
destinations through various initiatives including Dekho Apna Desh initiative, to diversify tourism. 
 
Environmental Sustainability and Socio -Cultural Sustainability are two key pillars in the National 
Strategy for Sustainable Tourism formulated by the Ministry. In line with the strategy, Travel for LiFE 
programme has been initiated to promote sustainable tourism in the country and to encourage tourists and 
tourism businesses to adopt sustainable tourism practices.  
 
The Swadesh Darshan Scheme of the Ministry has been revamped as Swadesh Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0) with 
the objective to develop sustainable and responsible tourism destinations following a tourist & destination 
centric approach. The Scheme encourages adoption of principles of sustainable tourism including 
environmental sustainability, socio-cultural sustainability and economic sustainability.  
 
Central financial assistance is being extended according to guidelines and based on proposals/ detailed 
project reports received from the States and UT Governments. The details of funds allocated for tourism 
infrastructure in Goa are given at Annexure. 
 
The details of Domestic Tourist Visits  (DTVs) and Foreign Tourist Visits  (FTVs) to Goa during 2021 -
2023:

2023 81.75 4.53

and employment.

ANSWERED ON- 19/12/2024 
 
SPORTS FACILITIES IN BIHAR 
 
2866 # SHRI SHAMBHU SHARAN PATEL: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
 
(a) whether Government has any plan to build international standard stadiums in the State of Bihar, 
if so, the details thereof; 
 
(b) by when Government proposes to start a world class sports academy in the State of Bihar, the 
details thereof; and 
 
(c) the plan of Government to promote games like Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Wrestling, Football, etc. in 
the State of Bihar that can be played with less resources? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (c) No, Sir. There is no plan under consideration in this Ministry to build international 
standard stadiums in the State of Bihar. Further, ‘sports’ being a State subject, the responsibility of 
development of sports infrastructure and promotion of games like Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Wrestling, 
Football etc. rests primarily with the State/Union Territory Governments. The Union Government 
supplements their efforts by bridging critical gaps.  
The details of the sports infrastructure sanctioned under Khelo India Scheme and NSDF, across the 
country, including in the State of Bihar, are available in public domain on the dashboard of the 
Ministry at https://mdsd.kheloindia.gov.in and http://www.nsdf.yas.gov.in/nsdfglance.html. State-
wise details of operational Khelo India Centres and Accredited Academies under the Khelo India 
Scheme, including in Bihar, are available at https://dashboard.kheloindia.gov.in/state-wise-khelo-
india-centers. 
The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports implements the following schemes to promote sports, 
including games like Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Wrestling, Football, etc. in the country, including in the 
State of Bihar: 
 
(i) Khelo India- National Programme for Development of Sports; (ii) Assistance to National Sports 
Federations; (iii) Special Awards to Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches; (iv) 
National Sports Awards; (v) Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons; (vi) Pandit Deendayal 
Upadhyay National Welfare Program for Sportspersons; (vii) National Sports Development Fund; 
and (viii) Running Sports Training Centres through Sports Authority of India. 
 
Details of the above schemes are available in the public domain on the websites of this Ministry and 
of Sports Authority of India (SAI).

KHELO INDIA RISING TALENT IDENTIFICATION 
 
2867 # SHRI NEERAJ DANGI: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
  
(a) the details of the salient features and objectives of the Khelo India Rising Talent Identification 
(KIRTI) programme;   
 
(b) the details of the target for evaluation of sports talent through this initiative; 
 
(c) the competitions in which the players registered in the first phase under the said scheme have 
been evaluated; and  
 
(d) the details of performance of sportspersons through the scheme, sport-wise and Statewise? 
  
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (d) The Khelo India Rising Talent Identification (KIRTI) programme, under the Khelo India 
Scheme of this Ministry, highlights key features such as the focus on early talent identification for 
athletes aged 9 to 18 years, especially from remote areas, through the use of IT tools. The 
programme aims to implement a uniform, structured approach for grassroots talent identification 
across all States/UTs using common tests, while standardizing fitness and sports-specific 
assessments to establish a Bharat Benchmark.  
 
The KIRTI assessment targets were set phase-wise, with Phase 1 aiming for 50,000 assessments, of 
which 49,834 were completed. In Phase 2, the target was 100,000 assessments, and a total of 
138,087 assessments have been completed as on date. The athletes participating in KIRTI 
assessments are subjected to a battery of 10 physical and sports-specific tests. These assessments 
are conducted in the disciplines of Archery, Athletics, Badminton, Boxing, Football, Hockey, 
Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Volleyball, Weightlifting, and Wrestling. The sport-wise and state-wise details 
of assessment of sportspersons through the scheme are at Annexure-I.

MY BHARAT PORTAL 
2868 DR. PARMAR JASHVANTSINH SALAMSINH: 
SHRI MADAN RATHORE: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state:  
 
(a) the primary objective of MY Bharat Portal, and its alignment with the vision of Viksit Bharat; 
(b) the number of institutions, activities, programmes and youths that officially registered on MY 
Bharat portal; 
(c) the initiatives undertaken to increase awareness and activ e participation of youth on the MY 
Bharat Portal; 
(d)  whether MY Bharat portal provides an opportunity for youth in India to articulate their skill sets 
and accomplishments and build a digital trail of their work; and 
(e)  whether there are plans to expand the MY Bharat Portal's features to include skill development, 
career counselling, and mental health resources for youth? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a). Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) is an autonomous body that has been set up by the Government 
of India which aims to provide an overarching Institutional mechanism which will provide equitable 
access to opportunities to youth to actualize their aspirations and build Viksit Bharat-across the entire 
spectrum of the Governments. It is envisioned that  My Bharat Portal will become a single window 
platform which would provide access to all the services and o pportunities available for youth in the 
entire country including marginalized section of the society aligning with the goal of Viksit Bharat. 
 
 (b)  As on 13.12.2024, the details are as follows: 
 
i. No. of Institutions : 5998  
ii. No. of Volunteering Activities: 76934  
iii. No. of experiential learning programs: 3377  
iv. No. of Youth registered - 16436987   
 
(c) In the recent times, Department of Youth Affairs has launched various initiatives to increase youth 
engagement and registration on the Mera Yuva Bharat portal. The most prominent initiatives among 
others are briefed below: 
419

 
i. MY Bharat Outreach Program: A total of 829 outreach programmes have been conducted for MY 
Bharat and total 53,447 youth have participated in these programmes. 
 
ii. Jan Jatiye Gaurav Diwas Padyatra: A total of 517 P adyatras were organised with participation of 
3.81 lakh Youth and others who joined the Padyatra honouring Bhagwan Birsa Munda. 
 
iii. Diwali with MY Bharat: Over 1.82 lakhs volunteers participated in various activities at 5,275 
locations in 500 districts across India. 
 
iv. Viksit Bharat Ambassador -  Yuva Connect Programme: The event was conducted across 15 
locations with a total participation of 12960 students. 
 
(d) and (e) MY Bharat offers "Volunteering for Bharat" and “Experiential Learning Programs 
(ELPs)” across diverse sectors, foster ing problem-solving, leadership and other essential soft skills 
in youth.  MY Bharat portal provides a dedicated web page to each registered youth to explain their 
skill-sets, educational profile and work profile. This is a shareable URL. Certificates earned through 
MY Bharat are also displayed on this profile. While profiles are private by default, youths have choice 
to make them public. Additionally, MY Bharat provides a CV builder tool enabling users to create 
customized resumes for personal and professional use. Since its inception  MY Bharat has actively 
engaged volunteers in various activities to enhance their skill sets ; some of which are mentioned 
below : 
 
• Experiential Learning Programs in Hospitals 
• Experiential Learning Programs in Post Offices 
• Experiential Learning Programs in Community Policing 
• Volunteering for Swachhta (Cleanliness initiatives) 
• Volunteering for Traffic Management 
• Workshops on Financial Literacy  
• Workshops on Mentorship 
 
To further support skill development and career counselling, MY Bharat has integrated the National 
Career Service and e -Shram portal providing convenient access to career counse lling and 
employment-related information.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
(DEPARTMENT OF SPORTS)  
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION No-2870 
ANSWERED ON 19/12/2024 
 
SAFETY OF ATHLETES 
 
2870 SHRI NARESH BANSAL: 
 DR. ANIL SUKHDEORAO BONDE: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the National Sports Federations have suitable mechanisms to ensure the safety of 
athletes; and 
 
(b) if so, the steps taken to monitor the safety of the athletes? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a)& (b) National Sports Federations (NSFs) are self -regulated autonomous bodies 
registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, Companies Act etc. and are governed 
by their own constitution and have their own mechanism to redress the grievances/ 
complaints filed with them by sportspersons.  
The Government emphasises on providing a safe environment to the athletes participating in 
sports. NSFs are re quired to implement safety protocols to ensure the safety and well -being 
of athletes. 
Sports Authority of India (SAI), an autonomous body under administrative control of the 
Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports,  has issued instructions to ensure a safe and positive 
environment by making all stakeholders aware  that there is an expectation, at all times, of  
appropriate behavior consistent with the corevalues of sportsmanship and appropriate moral  
conduct. In order to provide the safe environment in the sports,  the following measures have 
been advised to NSFs:  
i. Women Coach to mandatorily be a part of the contingent with female athletes during 
Domestic/ International camps and competition exposures.  
 
ii. Compliance Officer (Male & Female) to be appointed in all Nati onal Coaching Camps 
and Foreign Exposures. The roles and responsibilities of the Compliance Officer 
include communicating regularly with athletes and others to ensure that the guidelines 
are being followed as well as enforce the Standard Operating Procedur e on prevention 
of sexual harassment in sports. The Compliance Officer, among other duties, should 
422

ensure that if any member reports a violation, the same should be reported earliest to 
the responsible authorities.  
 
iii. Pre-Camp Sensitization modules to be de signed and presented to all athletes, coaches 
and support staffs together before commencement of any National Coaching Camp and 
Foreign Exposure.  
 
iv. Increase the strength of women Coaches/Support Staff in National Coaching Camps by 
respective NSFs.

PROMOTION OF HOCKEY AMONGST YOUNGSTERS 
 
2871 SHRI SATNAM SINGH SANDHU:   
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the details of steps taken to promote hockey amongst youngsters in the country; 
 
(b) the steps taken to boost and promote hockey in the State of Punjab; 
 
(c) the details of assistance provided to hockey players in the State of Punjab during the last 
five years; and 
 
(d) the details of the steps taken by Government to construct and renovate new hockey turfs 
in the State of Punjab in the last five years? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (d): Sports being as a State Subject, the responsibility to promote sports, including 
hockey among youngsters, primarily rests with the respective State/UT Government . Central 
Government supplements their efforts through its schemes viz. sports promotional schemes 
run by Sports Authority of India (SAI) and Khelo India Scheme.  
Under the Khelo India Scheme, 02 hockey fields, 02 Khelo India Centres and 04 Khelo India 
Accredited Academies, in the Hockey discipline are sanctioned in the State of Punjab. 
Further, 01 SAI Training Centre (STC), Badal, in hockey discipline, is operational in the 
State of Punjab. 
Additionally, the Khelo India Scheme provides comprehensive support to athletes, including 
scholarships, specialised training and coaching facilities, and access to world -class training 
facilities, which entail funding of ₹6.28 lakhs per annum per Khelo India Athlete (including 
₹10,000 per mo nth out-of-pocket allowance for each KIA). The budgetary details, including 
that for Punjab,  are available in public domain on the dashboard of the Ministry at  
https://dashboard.kheloindia.gov.in/ 
Further, t he Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports recognizes National Sports Federations 
(NSFs) for promotion and development of concerned sports disciplines. For promotion and 
development of sport of Hockey at national level the Hockey India has been recognized as 
NSF. The Central Government is supplementing the efforts of Hockey India by providing 
financial assistance for preparation and participation of Indian Hockey Teams in international 
sporting events, including expert training and coaching facilities for Hockey players.

KHELO INDIA SCHEME IN PUNJAB 
 
2872 SHRI SATNAM SINGH SANDHU: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
(a) the details of entitlements available to sportspersons and players since the inception of the Khelo 
India scheme, State-wise and year-wise;   
(b) the outcomes of the scheme for the State of Punjab; and  
(c) the details of the number of athletes from Punjab receiving a monthly assistance of ₹ 50,000 
from the Union Government? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) The 'Khelo India – National Programme for Development of Sports' was launched in 2016-17 
with the twin objectives of mass participation and promotion of excellence across the country. 
Under the component, “Sports Competition and Talent Development” of the Khelo India Scheme, 
talented sportspersons nationwide, are identified as a Khelo India Athlete (KIA). Under the 
component “Khelo India Centres & Sports Academies” of Khelo India Scheme, the identified 
talents are given option to join the accredited Khelo India academies and also provided financial 
assistance of Rs. 6.28 Lakh per annum [including Rs 1.20 Lakh as Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA)] 
towards training expenses, coaching, competitions exposure, education, equipment support, 
scientific support etc. State-wise details of Khelo India Athletes under the Khelo India Scheme 
across the country, including in the State of Punjab, are available in the public domain at 
https://dashboard.kheloindia.gov.in/state-wise-khelo-india-centers.  
 
(b) The Khelo India Scheme has contributed in the development of sports across the country. Key 
achievements include the approval of 323 new sports infrastructure projects, with a total sanctioned 
cost of Rs. 3073.67 crore, establishment of 1041 Khelo India Centres (KICs) aimed at training 
children, supporting former athletes, and enhancing grassroots sports infrastructure. Additionally, 
32 Khelo India State Centres of Excellence (KISCEs) have been notified, and 301 academies have 
been accredited. So far, 15 editions of the Khelo India Games have been conducted, with 
participation from over 48,000 athletes. The scheme has identified and supported 2781 Khelo India 
Athletes (KIAs) across the country, including in the State of Punjab who are provided with 
coaching, equipment, medical care, and a monthly Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA) of Rs. 10,000.  
 
As a outcome, over the past two years and the current year, KIAs have set a remarkable 5939 
national and 1424 international records across various competitions. At the 2022 Asian Games in 
425

Page 2 of 2 
 
Hangzhou, China, 124 out of 644 Indian athletes were KIAs, and they contributed significantly by 
winning 42 out of India’s 106 medals, including 9 Gold medals. For the Paris 2024 Olympics, 28 
KIAs are part of the Indian contingent of 117 athletes, highlighting the program's ongoing success 
and the critical role of KIAs in enhancing India’s presence in national and international sports 
events.  
 
(c) Under the Khelo India Scheme, there is no such provision of monthly assistance of ₹ 50,000 
from the Union Government.

PREPARATIONS FOR OLYMPICS 2028 
 
2874 SMT. SAGARIKA GHOSE: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether preparation for Olympic 2028 has begun, considering the poor performance in 
Olympic 2024; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; and 
 
(c) the reasons fo r poor performance of Indian athletes even after Government has spent 
considerable amount on their training and well-being? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (c) After conclusion of Paris Olympics 2024, the Mission Olympic Cell, which is 
headed by Director General, Sports Authority of India and comprises of former eminent 
sportspersons, sports administrators discussed on the learnings from the Paris Olympics and 
following are the major points that have emerged from deliberations: 
 
 Clear selection policy and training plan of athletes by NSFs. 
 Talent identification through strong domestic competition structure.  
 Integration of sports science to enhance sporting performances. 
 Development of coaches and Technical Officials and improving their competencies. 
 
Preparation for International events including Olympics is an ongoing and continuous process. 
Plans/Proposals of the National Sports Federations (NSFs) relating to training, competitive 
exposure, Coaches and sup port personnel including foreign coaches, for preparing 
429

sportspersons/teams for the international events including mega -sports events such as Olympics, 
Asian Games etc are deliberated and finalized in the Annual Calendar for Training and 
Competition (ACTC) meetings. 
 
The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports supports the Indian sportspersons/teams through various 
schemes, such as Scheme of Assistance to National Sports Federations and TOPS. The Ministry 
of Youth Affairs & Sports, the National Sports Federations (NSFs), including the Indian Olympic 
Association (IOA), and the Sports Authority of India (SAI) work in close coordination for 
providing best facilities, training, equipment support as also a wholesome nutritious diet required 
for preparation o f the teams and sportspersons for the forthcoming international sports events, 
including Olympics. 
 
Furthermore, Government has also established the National Centre of Sports Science and Research 
(NCSSR) at New Delhi to better integrate sports science into the overall sports ecosystem.

Initiatives taken to honour former/retired sportspersons 
2875 Smt. Sagarika Ghose: 
Will the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports be pleased to state: 
(a) whether any steps have been taken to honour former/retired sportspersons who have 
represented India in the past; 
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; 
(c) whether Government has ensured well-being of these athletes and taken record of their 
quality of living standards; and 
(d) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS  
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
(a) & (b): Yes, Sir. The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports honours former/retired sportspersons 
with the Arjuna (Lifetime) and Dronacharya (Lifetime) awards under the Scheme for the Arjuna 
Awards for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games and Scheme for Dronacha rya Award 
for the Outstanding coaches in Sports and Games respectively. 
(c) & (d): The Ministry of Youth Affairs and  Sports is providing assistanc for livelihood to 
sportspersons after their retirement in the form of monthly life -time pension under the scheme of 
“Sports Fund for Pension to Meritorious ranging from ₹12,000/ - to ₹20,000/ - per month for 
winning medals in Olympic Games, Paralympic Games, World Cup/World Championships, Asian 
Games, Para Asian Games and Commonwealth Games. The Ministry also p rovides financial 
assistance to sportspersons/their dependents now living in indigent circumstances, including 
suitable assistance to sportspersons for training, medical treatment, procurement of sports 
equipment, participation in national and internationa l sports events, etc. The financial assistance, 
under the Scheme to Sportspersons/their dependents, ranges from ₹2.50 lakh to₹10 lakh under this 
scheme.

2876 Smt. P.T. Usha:

BID TO HOST 2036 OLYMPIC GAMES AND PARALYMPICS 
 
2878 SHRI YERRAM VENKATA SUBBA REDDY: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether India submitted its Expression of Interest for conducting 2036 Olympic Games 
and Paralympics to International Olympic Committee (IOC); 
 
(b) to what extent holding Olympic Games  foster economic growth, social progress and 
youth empowerment; 
 
(c) the other contenders for 2036 Olympics and where India stands before them; and 
 
(d) whether India announced any host city for the Olympics, if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) & (b) Bidding to host Olympics in India is the responsibility of the Indian Olympic 
Association (IOA). On 01.10.2024 IOA issued Letter of Intent to International Olympic 
Committee (IOC) to host Olympic and Paralympic Games in India, in 2036.  Holding of such 
mega sporting event s accelerates the mo mentum of government efforts to  promote sports, 
including nurturing grassroots talent, inspiring healthier lifestyles, encouraging participation 
in sports , providing opportunities for youth to engage in sports , and creating economic 
legacies for generations. 
 
(c) & (d) Allotment of Olympics is done by IOC through a detailed host selection process 
prescribed by IOC, in which interested National Olympic Committees (NOCs) initiate the 
dialogue with the IOC, which led to continuous dialogue and then to targeted dialogue with  
the Future Host Commission of the IOC. Thereafter, the IOC Executive Board calls an 
election and the IOC Members vote for Hosting the Olympic Games.

3(i)  सािारण /वनयवमत  प्रक ृ वत के मामलों को बारी  के आिार  पर  पैनल काउंसेल (अपर  
एसिीआई/उप एसिीआई/ज्येष्ठ पैनल काउंसेल के वसिाय ) को स ंपा िा सकता है; 
3(ii)  यवि  मंत्रालय /विभाग वलखखत  रूप  में वकसी विशेष पैनल काउंसेल के नाम की वसफाररश  
करता  है, तो उसक े पास उवचत न्याय वचत्य  होना चावहए; 
3(iii)  महत्वपूणय, संिेिनशील और  उच्च पण िाले मामले, विसक े अंतगयत िे मामले भी है, 
विनमें उपबंि की संिैिावनक शखि  को चुन ती िी गई है, संबंवित मंत्रालय /विभाग के

अलग-अलग पैनल काउंसेल को स ंपा िा सकता है; 
3(v)  अपर  एसिीआई/उप एसिीआई/ज्येष्ठ पैनल काउंसेल के वसिाय  वकसी पैनल काउंसेल

भारत िा स्वदेशी थोररयम-आधाररत ररएक्टर िाययक्रम 
 
2721. श्री पी. विल्सन   
क्या प्रधानमांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  वक :-  
 
(क) सतत परमाणु ऊर्ाा क े  विकास क े  विए िेश क े  स्विेशी थोररयम-आधाररत ररएक्टर कायाक्रम की ितामान 
प्रगवत क्या है; 
 
(ख) क्या सरकार ने परमाणु ऊर्ाा सांयांत्रोां के विए, विशेष रूप से कम ऊर्ाा की उपिब्धता िािे क्षेत्रोां में, नए 
स्थानोां की पहचान की है; 
 
(ग) िेश भर में परमाणु सामग्री पररिहन की सुरक्षा बढ़ाने  क े  विए तैयार की र्ा रही नीवतयोां का ब्यौरा क्या  है; 
 
(घ) इांटरनेशनि थमोन्यूक्लियर एक्सपेररमेंटि ररएक्टर  (आईटीईआर) पररयोर्ना क े  अवतररक्त उन्नत परमाणु 
अनुसांधान क े  क्षेत्र में चि र हे अांतर ा ाष्ट्र ीय सहयोगोां का ब्यौरा क्या है ; और  
 
(ङ) हररत और सतत ऊर्ाा स्रोत क े  रूप में परमाणु ऊर्ाा क े  बारे में र्न र्ागरूकता और स्वीक ृ वत बढ़ाने क े  
विए क्या पहिें की र्ा रही हैं ?          
उत्तर 
 
राज्य मांत्री , कावमाक , िोक वशकायत और पेंशन तथा प्रधानमांत्री कायाािय (डॉ. वर्तेंद्र वसांह)  
 
(क)  भारत क े  विशाि थोररयम भांडार का उपयोग सांधारणीय तरीक े  से िीघाकाविक ऊर्ाा सांरक्षा क े  विए वकया 
र्ा एगा । थोररयम  (232Th) एक उपर्ाऊ  पिाथा है, वर्से  नावभकीय ईांधन के  सा थ नावभकीय ररएक्टर  में 
वकरणन  प्रवक्रया के माध्यम से विखांड्य पिाथा (233U) में पररिवतात  वकया  र्ाना  आिश्यक है। इस प्रकार  
उत्पावित भुक्तशेष ईांधन को 233U को पुनप्रााप्त करने  के विए पुनसंसावधत  करना  पड़ता है, उसक े बाि इस 
233U का  उपयोग करक े  िाांवित गुणोां क े  साथ ईांधन का  उत्पािन वकया  र्ाता  है। इस विशा में, आिश्यक 
अनुसांधान  एिां विकास वकया  र्ा  रहा  है। परमाणु  ऊर्ाा विभाग (डीएई) थोररयम  से सांबांवधत विवभन्न 
अनुसांधान  एिां विकास गवतविवधयोां में सांिग्न है। इन उपिक्लब्धयोां और  गवतविवधयोां के क ु ि मुख्य वबांिु 
वनम्नविक्लखत हैं :  
  
(i) बांडिोां में वनवहत थोररयम  ऑक्साइड (थोररया ) गुवटकाओां  का  उपयोग हमारे प्रचावित िावबत भारी 
पानी ररएक्टरोां (पीएचडब्ल्यूआर) के प्रारांवभक  क्रोडोां में वकया  गया  है और  इस वकरवणत  थोररयम  
ईांधन के प्रचािन और  पुन: उपयोग में महत्वपूणा अनुभि प्राप्त हुआ है। थोररया  आधाररत  ईांधन को 
डीएई की एक सांघटक इकाई भाभा परमाणु अनुसांधान क े न्द्र ( बीएआरसी ) के अनुसांधान  ररएक्टरोां  में 
भी वकरवणत  वकया  गया  है। इस प्रकार वकरणन  के बाि, बीएआरसी  की प्रयोगशािाओां  में इन ईांधन 
तत्वोां की र्ाांच  की गई है, वर्ससे  उत्क ृ ष्ट् पररणाम  वमिे हैं।  
 (ii) यूरेवनयम -233 प्राप्त करने  के विए अनुसांधान  ररएक्टरोां  के वकरवणत  थोररया  वपनोां को पुनःप्रक्रम वकया  
गया  है। पुनःप्राप्त यूरेवनयम -233 को 30 वकिोिाट (तापीय ) कावमनी  ररएक्टर  के विए ईांधन के रूप

घयेरू ऩयभाणु उद्योग भें निोन्भेष औय अनुसॊधान एिॊ विकास को फढािा देने के नरए कामानीनत का 
ब्मौया क्मा है?

(क )  देश भें ऩयभाणु ऊर्ाा रयएक्टयों के  कडर्ाइन स्थामी नहीॊ  हैं औय नए  नानबकीम विद्युत रयएक्टयों के  
कडर्ाइन भें विकनसत िैश्चिक भानकों, घटनाओॊ  औय प्र ारन  अनुबि , नानबकीम  प्रौद्योनगकी औय 
ऩदाथों भें अनुसॊधान  एिॊ विकास  इत्माकद भें निीनतभ  विकास  को  ध्मान भें यखा र्ाता है औय मह 
सुननश्चित ककमा  र्ाता है कक  िे सॊयऺा की  दृवि से अत्माधुननक हों। नानबकीम विद्युत सॊमॊत्रों का  
ननभााण उच् तभ सॊयऺा औय गुणित्ता भानकों के  अनुसाय ककमा  र्ाता है। विि नानबकीम  रयएक्टय 
सॊघ (डब््मूएएनओ) र्ैसे अॊतयााष्ट्रीम सॊगठनों द्वाया बायतीम नानबकीम विद्युत रयएक्टयों की बी 
सभकऺ सभीऺा की  र्ाती है औय बायतीम रयएक्टयों भें अॊतयााष्ट्रीम सिोत्तभ ऩद्धनतमों को  रागू  ककमा  
र्ाता है। उच् तभ सॊयऺा भानकों को  सुननश्चित कयने  के  नरए  एनऩीसीआईएर  औय एईआयफी द्वाया 
एक  भर्फूत फहु-स्तयीम सॊयऺा सभीऺा तॊत्र बी स्थावऩत ककमा गमा है। 
 
(ख)   नानबकीम विद्युत सॊमॊत्रों (एनऩीऩी) भें स्थावऩत बाबा ऩयभाणु अनुसॊधान केंद्र की ऩमााियणीम 
सिेऺण प्रमोगशाराएॊ (ईएसएर) ननमनभत रूऩ से एनऩीऩी स्थरों के आस -ऩास विनबन्न 
ऩमााियणीम व्मूहों (भैकिक्स) की ननगयानी कयती हैं औय ऩयभाणु ऊर्ाा ननमाभक ऩरयषद द्वाया 
ननधाारयत ननमाभक सीभाओॊ के अनुऩारन का ननरूऩण कयती हैं औय इस प्रकाय एनऩीऩी का 
सॊयश्चऺत प्र ारन सुननश्चित कयती हैं।

फीएआयसी द्वाया िषा 2000 से 2020 तक एनऩीऩी स्थरों के आस-ऩास ककए गए 20 िषों के

एनिामयनभेंट” 914 (2024) 169936 भें प्रकानशत ककमा गमा है।

तैनात करने क े  गलए भारत 6जी विज़न दस्तािेज जारी ककया है।  
ii. सरकार  देश में अनुसंधान एिं विकास तथा निाचार को बढािा देने क े  गलए 6जी टेराहर्टजष

को मैप ककया गया है:  
• रेलटेल/बीएसएनएल/बीबीएनएल/एमटीएनएल/गेल/ सड़क पररिहन एिं राजमागष

ओएफसी।

क े बल (ओएफसी)।

(अप्रैल 2024)। कनाषटक  में लगभग  49 हजार  मोबाइल टािर।  
• लगभग  2.29 लाख पीएम-िाणी िाई-फाई हॉटस्पॉट (निंबर 2024)। कनाषटक में  
लगभग  20 हजार।   
• 4जी सेचूरेशन  पररयोजना क े  17,286 प्रस्तावित मोबाइल टािर। विगभन्न यूएसओएफ

 (सुश्री शोभा क ारान्िलाजे) 
 
(क) से (ग .): रोजगार और बेरोजगारी पर आधधकाररक डेटा िावर्षषक आिधधक श्रम बि सिेक्षण 
(पीएिएफएस) के माध्यम से एकत्र ककया जाता है , जो 2017 -18 से साांजययकी और कायषक्रम 
कायाषन्ियन मांत्रािय (एमओएसपीआई) द्िारा आयोजजत ककया जाता है। सिेक्षण अिधध प्रततिर्षष 
ज ुिाई से ज ून त क  होत ी है।  
 
निीनतम उपिब्ध िा वर्षषक  पीएिएफएस ररपोटों के अनुसार, अनुमातनत  बेरोज गारी द र 
(यूआर) में क मी क ी प्रिृवि है। सामान्य जथितत के आधार पर 15 िर्षष और उससे अधध क  आयु के 
व्यजक्तयों का बेरोजगारी दर िर्षष 2021-22 में 4.1% से घटकर िर्षष 2023-24 में 3.2% हो गई 
है। 
इसके अिािा , िर्षष 2021-22, 2022-23 और 2023-24 के दौरान सामान्य जथितत के 
आधार पर 15 िर्षष और उससे अधध क  आयु के व्यजक्त यों के लिए रोज गार द शाषने िािा अनुमातनत  
क ामगार ज नसांयया अनुपात  (डब््यूपीआर) क्रमशिः 52.9%, 56.0% और 58.2% है। पीएिएफएस 
ररपोटों में विथत ृत  िर्षष-िार, राज्य-िार सूचना उपिब्ध  है जज से साांजययकी और कायषक्रम कायाषन्ियन 
मांत्रािय की िेबसाइट https://www.mospi.gov.in/download-
reports?main_cat=ODU5&cat=All&sub_category=All पर देखा जा सकता है।

सुविध ा प्रद ान क रने के लिए 5 योजनाओां और पहि सांबांधी प्रधानमांत्री पैकेज की घोर्षणा की है।

श्रम पोर्टल  के साथ एक ीक ृत कक या गया है और क् या असंगठित कामगारों को एनसीएस

(ग)  सभी राज्यों के पोर्टल ों क ो एन सीएस पोर्टल  के साथ एक ीक ृत क रन े क ी समय-सीमा क्या है?

 (सुश्री शोभा क ारान्िलाजे)

प्लेर्फॉमट [www.ncs.gov.in] के माध्यम से प्रदान करने के ललए वन -स्र्ॉप समाधान है।

िबकक 7 राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र, रोिगार चाहने वालों के पंिीकरण के ललए सीधे एनसीएस पोर्टल 
का उपयोग कर रहे हैं।

(क)  क्या सरक ार ने राष्ट्र ीय स्तर पर रोज गार क ी मांग और आपूर्ति क ो डिजज टाइज  क रने के

वार , राज्य-वार और क्षेत्र-वार कुि ककतनी ररजक्तयों पर भती कराई गई है ; 
(ग)  क्या एनसीएस पोटिि के माध्यम से अंतरािष्ट्रीय रोजगार अवसरों को भी ववज्ञावपत ककया 
जा रहा है , यदि हााँ, तो पोटिि पर ववज्ञावपत इन रोजगारों का िायरा और सीमा क्या है ; 
और 
(घ)  एनसीएस पोटिि क ी शुरु आत से अब  तक  इसके माध्यम से अंतरािष्ट्र ीय स्तर क ी कक तनी

उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (सुश्री शोभा क ारान्िलाजे)  
 
(क) से ( घ): श्रम और रोजगार मंत्रािय, भारत सरकार राष्ट्रीय कररयर सेवा (एनसीएस) पोटिि 
चिा रहा है , जो र्नजी और सरकारी क्षेत्रों की नौकररयों , ऑनिाइन और ऑफिाइन रोजगार  मेिों 
की जानकारी , नौकरी खोज और लमिान , कररयर परामशि , व्यावसार्यक मागििशिन, कौशि ववकास 
पाठ्यक्रमों की जानकारी , कौशि/प्रलशक्षण कायिक्रम आदि सदहत कररयर से संबंधित सेवाएं डिजजटि 
प्िेटफॉमि [www.ncs.gov.in] के माध्यम से प्रिान करने के लिए वन -स्टॉप समािान है। 
 
राष्ट्रीय कररयर सेवा (एनसीएस) पोटिि के माध्यम से इसकी स्थापना के बाि से लिंग-वार , 
राज्य-वार और क्षेत्र-व ार ज ुटाई गई कुि ररजक्तयों क ी संख्या क्रमशिः अनुब ंि-I, अनुब ंि-II और 
अनुब ंि-III में िी गई है। 
 
एनसीएस पोटिि पर अंतरािष्ट्र ीय नौक ररयों के लिए मॉड्यूि अप्रैि, 2022 से शुरू  कक या 
गया था जो  वव िेश मंत्रािय (एमईए) पंज ीक ृत भती एज ेंटों क ो एनसीएस पोटिि पर अंतरािष्ट्र ीय 
नौक री के अव सर पोस्ट क रने क ी सुवव िा प्रिान क रता है। 15 नवंबर , 2024 तक , भती एजेंटों ने 
एनसीएस पोटिि पर 17,169 अंतरािष्ट्रीय ररजक्तयों को पोस्ट ककया है।

श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (सुश्री शोभा क ारान्िलाजे)  
 
(क) से (ड .): श्रम और रोजगार मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार , 2015 से राष्ट्रीय कररयर सेवा (एनसीएस) 
पोर्टल चला रहा है जो र्नजी और सरकारी क्षेत्रों से नौकररयों , ऑनलाइन और ऑफलाइन रोजगार  
मेलों की जानकारी , रोजगार  िोज और लमलान , कररयर परामशट , व्यावसार्यक मागटिशटन, कौशल 
ववकास पाठ्यक्रमों की जानकारी , कौशल / प्रलशक्षण कायटक्रमों आदि सदहत कररयर से संबंधधत 
सेवाएं एक डडक्जर्ल प्लेर्फॉमट [www.ncs.gov.in] क े  माध्यम से प्रिान करने क े  ललए वन -स्र्ॉप 
समाधान है। एनसीएस पोर्टल को 23 राज्यों/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों के  पोर्टल ों क े  साथ एक ीक ृ त कक या 
गया है , जबकक 7 राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र रोजगार चाहने वालों क े  पंजीकरण क े  ललए सीधे एनसीएस 
पोर्टल का उपयोग कर रहे हैं।  
15 नवंबर , 2024 तक , एनसीएस पोर्टल पर 3.53 करोड़ से अधधक ररक्क्तयों जुर्ाई गई हैं और 
36.23 लाि से अधधक  र्नयोक्ताओं ने पंजीकरण ककया है । रोजगार  चाहने वालों द्वारा रर ज म 
सदहत प्रिान की गई जानकारी नौकरी लमलान क े  ललए पोर्टल पर उपलब्ध है।

2800. श्री सी. वी. षनमुगम:

(क)  देश में कममचारी राज्य बीमा ननगम (ईएसआईसी) के कायमशील अस्पतालों और औषधालयों का ब्यौरा 
क्या है और प्रत्येक अस्पताल में राज्य-वार , वव शेषक र तमम लन ाडु म ें ककतने चचककत्सक तैनात ककए 
गए हैं;   
(ख)  देश म ें वव शेषक र तमम लन ाडु में ईएसआईसी अस्पतालों और औषधालयों में चचककत्सक-रोगी अन ुपात म ें 
सुधार क रन े के मलए क्या क द म  उठाए गए हैं; और  
(ग)  तमम लन ाडु म ें ईएसआईसी के पैन ल म ें शामम ल अस्पतालों क ा ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत् तर 
 
श्रम और रोजगार राज् य मंत्री 
(सुश्री शोभा कारान् िलाजे) 
 
(क ) से (ग): वतममान में , ईएसआई लाभाचथमयों को चचककत्सा देखभाल सेवाएं प्रदान करने के मलए देश भर में 
165 कममचारी राज्य बीमा (ईएसआई) अस्पताल और 1590 ईएसआई औषधालय हैं। ईएसआई अस्पतालों और 
औषधालयों का राज्य/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रवार ब्यौरा क्रमशः अन ुब ंध-I और अन ुब ंध-II में ददया गया है।  165 
ईएसआई अस्पतालों और 1590 ईएसआई औषधालयों में से 59 अस्पताल और 36 औषधालय सीधे ईएसआई 
ननगम द्वारा चलाए जाते हैं। 59 ईएसआई अस्पतालों और 36 औषधालयों में काम करने वाले चचककत्सकों 
का ब्यौरा क्रमशः अन ुब ंध-III और अन ुब ंध-IV म ें दद या गया है। तमम लन ाडु म ें 197 अस्पताल ईएसआईसी के 
पैनल में शाममल हैं।   
  
ईएसआईसी अस्पतालों और संस्थाओं में चचककत्सकों की भती एक सतत प्रकक्रया है। ईएसआईसी ने 
हाल ही में बीमा चचककत्सा अचधकारी (आईएमओ) ग्रेड -II, ववशेषज्ञ ग्रेड-II (वररष्ठ स्केल/ जूनन यर स्केल) और 
मशक्षण संकाय के पद के मलए चयननत 1323 अभ्यचथमयों को  तमम लन ाडु सदहत वव मभन्न  राज्यों म ें स्स्थत 
ईएसआईसी अस्पतालों और चचककत्सा कॉलेजों में तैनाती के मलए नन युस्क्त-प्रस्ताव भेजा है।

“ईएसआईसी अस्पतालों में चिककत्सक-रोगी अनुपात” के संबंध में श्री सी. वी. षनमुगम द्वारा दिनांक

ईएसआईसी योजना के अंतगगत िावों का ननपटान  
 
2803. श्री एम. शन मुगमः 
श्री वाइकोः 
 
क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह ब त ाने क ी क ृपा क रेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  त मम लनाडु सहहत  देश भर म ें क म मचारी राज्य ब ीम ा (ईएसआई) योजना के अंत गमत  नाम ांकक त  क ाम गारों क ी संख्या के 
संबंध में वतममान आंकडों का राज्य -वार/क्षेत्र-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख)  अनौपचाररक क्षेत्रों, ववशेषकर ग्रामीण और अधम-शहरी क्षेत्रों में पात्र कामगारों के बीच जागरूकता  बढाने और उनके 
नाम ांक न म ें व ृद्धध  क रने के मलए क्या उपाय कक ए जा रहे हैं; 
(ग)  क्या इसके अंत गमत  प्रदान क ी जाने व ाली स्व ास््य देखभाल सेव ाओं क ी गुण व त्ता म ें, ववशेष रूप से इन सेवाओं तक 
पहुंच और प्रतत किया सम य के संदभम म ें सुध ार क रने के मलए क ोई वव मशष्ट पहल क ी गई हैं और यहद हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी 
ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(घ)  सरक ार द्व ारा ब ीमम त  व्यक्क्त यों के मलए दाव ों क ा तनपटान और सेव ा प्रदायगी म ें वव लंब  से संब ंधध त  म ुद्दों क ा सम ाध ान 
करने के मलए क्या कदम उठाए जा रहे हैं ? 
 
उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री 
(सुश्री शोभा कारान्िलाजे) 
 
(क ):         त मम लनाडु राज्य सहहत  देश भर म ें हदनांक  31.3.2024 क ी क्स्ितत  के अनुसार क म मचारी राज्य ब ीम ा (ईएसआई) 
योजना के तहत नामांककत कममचाररयों का ब्यौरा संलग्न है। 
 
(ख):         ईएसआई अधध तनयम  उन क ारखानों और प्रतत ष्ठानों पर लागू होत ा है जो म ौसम ी क ारखानों क ो छोडक र 10 या 
इससे अधध क  व्यक्क्त यों (सरक ारी क ारखानों सहहत ) क ो रोजगार म ुहैया क रात े हैं और अधध सूधचत  क्षेत्र म ें 21,000 रुपए  प्रतत माह 
(तनिःशक्त व्यक्क्तयों के मामले में 25,000 रुपए  प्रतत माह) तक वेतन प्राप्त करते हैं। अतिः यह अधधतनयम अनौपचाररक क्षेत्रों 
(असंगहठत  क्षेत्र) पर लागू नहीं होता है। ईएसआईसी अपनी वेबसाइट और ववमभन्न सोशल मीडडया हैंडल के माध्यम से ईएसआई 
योजना के लाभों के बारे में अवगत कराने के मलए जन जागरूकता अमभयान चलाता है।  
 
(ग) से (घ):  कममचारी राज्य बीमा तनगम ने ईएसआईएस धचककत्सा अवसंरचना की समीक्षा करने और इसकी धचककत्सा 
अव संरचना म ें सुध ार और उन्नयन हेत ु कममयों के  क्षेत्रों की पहचान करने के मलए कॉमन सपोटम ममशन तैयार ककया है। 
धचकक त्सा आयुक्त , जोनल ऑकिसर इसक ी प्रभाव शीलत ा क ा म ूलयांक न क रने और तनदानात्म क  उपायों क ा सुझाव  देने के मलए 
क म मचारी राज्य ब ीम ा स्व ास््य सुवव ध ा केन्र ों क ा तनयमम त  दौरा क रत े हैं। इसके अततररक्त , म ुख्यालय म ें तनयमम त  ब ैठक ों के 
माध्यम से भी प्रभावशीलता का आकलन ककया जाता है। इसके अलावा , ईएसआईसी ने रोगी देखभाल , सुरक्षा और सेव ा देने हेत ु 
उच्च म ानक ीक रण  सुतनक्चचत  क रने के मलए सेव ा स्त र त ैयार कक या है। 
 
             क म मचारी राज्य ब ीम ा तनगम  ब ीमम त  व्यक्क्त यों के धचकक त्सा प्रतत पूतत म बब लों के दाव ों के सम य पर तनपटान हेत ु 
तनयममत तनगरानी कर रहा है। िीलड कायामलयों को बबल प्राप्त होने के  30 हदनों के भीत र धचकक त्सा प्रतत पूतत म दाव े क ा तनपटान 
करने का तनदेश हदया गया है।

2804. श्री संजय क ु मार झा: 
 
क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क)  राष्ट्रीय कररयर सेवा (एनसीएस) पोर्टल क े  उद्देश्य क्या हैं; 
(ख)  िेश में रोजगार कायाटलयों और आिशट कररयर क े न्द्रों (एमसीसी) की राज्य-वार/जजला -वार  संख्या ककतनी 
है; 
(ग)  िेश में राज्य-वार और जबहार में जजला -वार ककतने रोजगार कायाटलयों का एमसीसी क े  रूप में उन्नयन 
ककया गया है ; 
(घ)  रोजगार कायाटलयों की जथिजत और ब्यौरा क्या है तिा एनसीएस पोर्टल पर पंजीक ृत लाभाजियों/ नौकरी 
तलाशने वाले व्यजियों/जनयोिाओं की संख्या ककतनी है; 
(ड.) क्या सरकार की और अजिक रोजगा र कायाटलय/एमसीसी थिाजपत करने की योजना है और यकि हां , तो 
तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है; और  
(च)  सरकार द्वारा एनसीएस पोर्टल पर और अजिक जनयोिाओं को पंजीक ृ त कराने क े जलए उठाए गए  किमों 
का ब्यौरा कया है? 
 
उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (सुश्री शोभा कारा न्द्िलाजे)  
 
(क) से (च): श्रम और रोजगार मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार राष्ट्रीय कररयर सेवा (एनसीएस) पोर्टल चला रहा है, जो 
एक जडजजर्ल प्लेर्फॉमट [www.ncs.gov.in] क े माध्यम से जनजी और सरकारी क्षेत्रों की नौकररयों, ऑनलाइन 
और ऑफलाइन रोजगार मेलों की जानकारी , रोजगार खोज और जमलान , कररयर परामशट , व्यावसाजयक 
मागटिशटन, कौशल जवकास पाठ्यक्रमों की जानकारी , कौशल/प्रजशक्षण कायटक्रम आकि सजहत कररयर से संबंजित 
सेवाएं प्रिान करने क े  जलए वन-थर्ॉप समािान है।  
 
25.11.2024 तक , िेश में 1008 रोजगार कायाटलय जथित हैं। इसक े  अलावा , एनसीएस पररयोजना क े 
तहत, सरकार ने 400 मॉडल कररयर सेंर्र (एमसीसी) को मंजूरी िी है , जजसमें 370 रोजगार कायाटलय भी 
शाजमल हैं, जजन्द्हें एमसीसी क े  रूप में अपग्रेड ककया गया है।

रोजगार कायाटलयों और मॉडल कररयर क ें रों का राज्यवार जववरण अनुबंि-I में किया गया है तिा जबहार 
क े  थिानवार रोजगार कायाटलयों , जहां मॉडल कररयर क ेंरों को मंजूरी िी गई है , का जववरण अनुबंि -II में किया 
गया है। 
   
15 नवंबर 2024 तक , एनसीएस पोर्टल पर 3.53 करोड़ से अजिक ररजियों जुर्ाई गई हैं तिा 36.23 
लाख से अजिक जनयोिाओं ने पंजीकरण कराया है।  
 
एनसीएस पोर्टल पर अजिक से अजिक जनयोिाओं को पंजीक ृ त करना एक सतत और गजतशील प्रकक्रया 
है। इसे सुजविाजनक बनाने क े  जलए , श्रम और रोजगार मंत्रालय ने थर्ाफफ ं ग/प्लेसमेंर् संगठनों और जनजी नौकरी 
पोर्टलों क े  साि समझौता ज्ञापनों पर हथताक्षर ककए हैं, एनसीएस पोर्टल पर एमएसएमई जनयोिाओं को पंजीक ृ त 
करने क े  जलए एमएसएमई मंत्रालय क े  उद्यम पोर्टल क े  साि एकीकरण ककया है तिा थिानीय थतर पर जनयोिाओं 
को पंजीक ृ त करते हुए जवजभन्न जजलों में मॉडल क ै ररयर क ेंर भी थिाजपत ककए हैं।

(क ) से (छ): सरकार  ने  बाल श्रम (प्रनतषेि एर्ं पर्ननयमन ) अधिननयम , 1986 अधिननयममत  ककया  है।

ननधि  के  गठन  करने  का  प्रार्िान ककया  गया है, जिसे बाल और ककिोर  श्रम प ुन र्ाास कोष  कहा  िाएगा।

श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री 
(सुश्री शोभा कारान्िलाजे) 
 
(क ) से  (घ): श्रम और रोजगार  मंत्रालय ने  ठदनांक  26 अगस्त, 2021 को  ई-श्रम पोर्टल का  शुभारंभ ककया  
है। ई-श्रम पोर्टल पर राज्यों/संघ  राज्य क्षेत्रों के  प्रवासी कामगारों  सठहत  असंगठित  कामगारों  के  पंजीकरण  
की  स ुवव ध ा प्रदान की  गई है। इसमें  असंगठित  कामगार  स्व-घोषणा के  आधार  पर पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण  भी 
कर सकता है। ई-श्रम पोर्टल का  मुख्य उद्देश्य आधार  के  साथ  ज ुड़े प्रवासी कामगारों  सठहत  असंगठित  
कामगारों  का  एक  राष्ट्रीय डेर्ाबेस तैयार करना  और ऐसे  कामगारों  को  मौज ूदा सामाजजक  स ुरक्षा और 
क्याणकारी  योजनाओं  के  तहत पंजीकरण  की  स ुवव ध ा प्रदान करना  है। ठदनांक  15.12.2024 की  जस्थनत 
के  अन ुस ार अब तक  इस  पोर्टल पर 30.47 करोड़ कामगारों  ने  पंजीकरण  करा  सलया है। 
 
श्रम और रोजगार  मंत्रालय ने  ठदनांक  21 अक्र्ूबर, 2024 को  ई-श्रम- "वन -स्र्ॉप-स ॉ्यूशन " का  
शुभारंभ ककया।  ई-श्रम- "वन -स्र्ॉप-स ॉ्यूशन " में ववसभन्न  सामाजजक  स ुरक्षा/क्याणकारी  योजनाओं  को  
एकल  पोर्टल अथाटत ई-श्रम पर एक ीक ृत करना  शासमल है।

आवास  योजना -ग्रामीण (पीएमएवाई -जी ), महात्मा गांधी  राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार  गारंर्ी अधधननयम  
(मनरेगा ) शासमल हैं। 
 
भारत सरकार  ने  महामारी की  शुरु आत में वंदे  भारत समशन  के  तहत लौर्ने वाले  नागररकों  के  
सलए स्वदेश (रोजगार  सहायता  के  सलए क ुशल कामगार  आगमन  डेर्ाबेस) पहल की शुरू व ात की  थी। 
स्वदेश स्कीम कौशल  ववकास  और उद्यमशीलता मंत्रालय, नागर  ववमानन  मंत्रालय और ववदेश  मंत्रालय 
की  एक  स ंयुक्त पहल है जजसका  उद्देश्य अपने  कौशल  और अन ुभव  के  आधार  पर लौर्ने वाले  नागररकों  
का  एक  डेर्ाबेस तैयार करना  है। 
 
आवासन  और शहरी कायट  मंत्रालय (एमओएचयूए) ने  ठदनांक  31.07.2020 को  प्रधानमंत्री आवास  
योजना - शहरी (पीएमएवाई -यू) की  एक  उप-योजना  के  रूप  में ररयायती दर पर ककराये  के  आवास  पररसरों  
(एआरएचसी ) का  शुभारंभ ककया  है,जजसका  उद्देश्य शहरी प्रवाससयों/गरीबों को  उनके  कायटस्थल के  पास  
सम्मानजनक  जीवन  की  स ुवव ध ाएं प्रदान करना  है।  
 
कोववड -19 महामारी के  दौरान  नए  रोजगार  के  स ृज न  और रोजगार  के  न ुक स ान  की  पुन बटहाली के  
सलए ननयोक्ताओं को  प्रोत्साठहत करने  के  सलए ठदनांक  1 अक्र्ूबर, 2020 से  आत्मननभटर भारत रोजगार  
योजना  (एबीआरवाई ) की  शुरु आत की  गई थी।  
 
इसके  तहत लाभाधथटयों के  पंजीकरण  की  अंनतम नतधथ 31.03.2022 थी। योजना  के  तहत ठदनांक  
31 माचट, 2022 तक  पंज ीक ृत लाभाधथटयों को  पंजीकरण  की  तारीख से  2 वषट  तक  लाभ समलता रहेगा। 
 
ठदनांक  31.03.2024 तक  की  जस्थनत के  अन ुस ार देश में क ुल 60.49 लाख कमटचाररयों  ने  इस  
योजना  का  लाभ प्राप्त कक या है।

उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (स ुश्री शोभा क ारान्िलाजे) 
 
(क) से (ग): भारत में रोजगार/बेरोजगारी संके तक का आधिकाररक डेटा स्रोत सांख्ययकी और 
काययक्रम कायायन्वयन मंत्रालय (एमओएसपीआई) द्वारा 2017-18 से आयोख्जत आवधिक श्रम बल 
सवेक्षण (पीएल एफएस) है। सवेक्षण क ी अवधि हर साल  जुल ाई से जून  होती है। न वीन तम वार्षयक  
पीएल एफएस ररपोटय में उपल ब्ि आंक ड़ों के अन ुसार, रोजगार को दशायने वाला अन ुमानन त कामगार  
जन संयया अन ुपात (डब््यूपीआर) यानी 15 वषय और उससे अधिक  आयु के व्यख्क्तय़ों के लल ए 
सामान्य ख्स्िनत पर वषय 2017-18 में 46.8% से बढ़कर 2023-24 में 58.2% हो गया है। 
 
आदटयकफलशयल  इंटेलल जेंस (एआई) के क ारण कुछ नेमी प्रकार की  नौकररय़ों पर प्रभाव हो 
सकता है , लेककन इससे र्वलभन्न डेटा र्वज्ञान, डेटा क्यूरेशन  आदद  में रोजगार सृजन  भी होगा। 
इसके ललए रीख्स्कललंग और अपख्स्कललंग की आवश्यकता होगी, ख्जसके ललए सरकार र्वशेष रूप से 
इलेक्रॉननकी  और सूचन ा प्रौद्योधगक ी मंत्राल य (एमईआईटीवाई) ने आदटयकफलशयल इंटेललजेंस सदह त 
10 नई/उभरती प्रौद्योधगककय़ों में रोजगार के ललए आईटी क्षेत्र से जुडे क ालमयक ़ों क ी री-
ख्स्कललंग/अप-ख्स्कललंग के  ललए ' फ्यूचर ख्स्क ्स प्राइम' क ाययक्रम शुरू  कक या है। इस क ाययक्रम के 
तहत अब तक 18.56 ल ाख से अधिक  उम्मीद वाऱों न े फ्यूचर ख्स्क ्स प्राइम पोटयल  पर साइन -अप 
ककया है , ख्जनमें से 3.37 ल ाख से अधिक  उम्मीद वाऱों न े अपन ा क ोसय पूरा क र लल या है।
